about: 생산/외주 재계산 ☑ (원본 2026-10-22 실측: BOM A 2→3 + 재계산 → 생산입고 I 소모 -20 → -30) · 기본BOM 사용중단 글 · 흐름 숫자(지시 → 입고 → 재고). 만든 자료는 끝에 지운다(품목은 이력이 남아 남는다).

shots.name: BOM 재계산 ☑ — 지시 10 입고 I 뒤 A 80 · B 90 · 제품 10 → BOM 소모 A 2 → 3 저장 + 재계산 → A 70 (원본 -20 → -30 같은 움직임), 기본BOM 사용중단은 막힘(원본 글)
steps: js:(async()=>{const H=(m,b)=>({method:m,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const J=(m,p,b)=>fetch('/api'+p,H(m,b)).then(async(r)=>({s:r.status,b:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));const S=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('m17'));const st=async()=>{const d=(await J('GET','/stock')).b;const q=(id)=>Number(d.filter(r=>r.itemId===id&&r.warehouseId===S.wh).reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.quantity),0));return [q(S.a),q(S.b),q(S.p)].join('/')};sessionStorage.setItem('m17s1',await st());return true})()

js:(async()=>{const H=(m,b)=>({method:m,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const J=(m,p,b)=>fetch('/api'+p,H(m,b)).then(async(r)=>({s:r.status,b:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));const S=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('m17'));const st=async()=>{const d=(await J('GET','/stock')).b;const q=(id)=>Number(d.filter(r=>r.itemId===id&&r.warehouseId===S.wh).reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.quantity),0));return [q(S.a),q(S.b),q(S.p)].join('/')};const bom=(await J('GET','/boms')).b.find(x=>x.productId===S.p);const r=await J('PATCH','/boms/'+bom.id+'/active?active=false');sessionStorage.setItem('m17s2',r.s+'|'+(r.b&&r.b.message||''));return true})()
expect:sessionStorage.getItem('m17s2')==='400|기본BOM은 사용중단할 수 없습니다.\n기본BOM 변경 후 다시 시도하시기 바랍니다.'

js:(async()=>{const H=(m,b)=>({method:m,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const J=(m,p,b)=>fetch('/api'+p,H(m,b)).then(async(r)=>({s:r.status,b:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));const S=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('m17'));const st=async()=>{const d=(await J('GET','/stock')).b;const q=(id)=>Number(d.filter(r=>r.itemId===id&&r.warehouseId===S.wh).reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.quantity),0));return [q(S.a),q(S.b),q(S.p)].join('/')};await J('POST','/boms',{productId:S.p,lines:[{componentId:S.a,quantity:3},{componentId:S.b,quantity:1}]});const t=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);const r=await J('POST','/productions/recalculate-consumption',{productId:S.p,from:t.slice(0,8)+'01',to:t});sessionStorage.setItem('m17s3',JSON.stringify(r.b)+'|'+await st());return true})()

js:(async()=>{const H=(m,b)=>({method:m,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const J=(m,p,b)=>fetch('/api'+p,H(m,b)).then(async(r)=>({s:r.status,b:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));const S=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('m17'));const st=async()=>{const d=(await J('GET','/stock')).b;const q=(id)=>Number(d.filter(r=>r.itemId===id&&r.warehouseId===S.wh).reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.quantity),0));return [q(S.a),q(S.b),q(S.p)].join('/')};const ps=(await J('GET','/productions')).b.filter(x=>x.productId===S.p);for(const x of ps){await J('DELETE','/productions/'+x.id)}await J('DELETE','/work-orders/'+S.wo);const bom=(await J('GET','/boms')).b.find(x=>x.productId===S.p);if(bom)await J('DELETE','/boms/'+bom.id);sessionStorage.setItem('m17s4',await st());return true})()
